reviews.text:
This app is an extremely pointless time waster and nothing more. If it sounds too good to be true, in most cases it is. I won’t beat around the bush with my opinion: you pay them by watching all of these ads so they can accrue revenue and they promise to pay you but whenever you get to the minimum threshold to withdraw (2,000,000 for $35), guess what? “Today’s quota is used up. Come back tomorrow” is what you’re faced with. No matter which withdrawal method you select, it’s all the same result. 

Add to that, 2,000,000 isn’t even $35. I’ve finally reached just a hair over 2,000,000 and mine says $33 and some change. How does withdrawing $35 when I’ve only “earned” $33 make any sense from a logical financial standpoint? 

There were many clues that this app wasn’t legit. For one, the prizes. Simple bait and switch to get you to watch more videos. Progress hasn’t gone over 99% in 3 days as of this writing despite doing all the daily challenges and progress moving rather quickly only days before so strike one.

Strike two is that only once have I been able to watch all 100 videos in the daily tasks. It’ll usually let me get to 99 but then tell me XP is used up for the day and stops sending me XP. You can keep watching videos but you won’t get anything for them. 

Strike three is that it’s just constant ads. EVERYTHING about this app is ads ads ads. 

All the tedium and issues with this app would be worth it if they actually paid, but by the time you figure out the game it’s too late. They got your time (which can be hours a day) and got paid for the ad revenue for your mind-numbing work and left you with nothing except lost time that could’ve been spent doing something better. 

If customer service comes to me with a solution that actually fixes my problem with withdrawing, I’d change my rating but not banking on that at all. If there is a customer service line, being expeditious is not in their playbook. 

Don’t waste your time on this app. As if the plethora of other negative reviews wasn’t sufficient enough, here’s another more detailed one for pile.
